subject: Post-demo: token economics, monthly spend band & PO path for CobaltAI
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@cobaltai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: token economics, monthly spend band & PO path for CobaltAI

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for taking the demo with us today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Recap from the call:
- Estimated monthly token range: ~200M to 350M tokens (in early pilot-to-production ramp).
- Target unit economics discussed: range of roughly $600–$900 per 1M tokens depending on committed band and term.
- Key procurement ask from your side: clarity on PO threshold and payment terms (Net 30/45), and sample SOW.

What we propose (next steps):
1) Pilot: 45-day pilot sandbox — up to 100M tokens — billed at a pilot rate (creditable to committed contract).
2) Commit bands for contracting discussion: we’ll propose three options you can pick from (examples below).
3) Procurement: please confirm procurement contact + typical PO lead-time (we often see 2–6 weeks for mid-market).
4) Deliverables from us: draft SOW and pricing table (attached next internal note) + DocuSign link when ready.

Example commit band (internal — will finalize with legal/pricing):
- Band A: 200M tokens/month — $750 per 1M tokens
- Band B: 300M tokens/month — $650 per 1M tokens
- Band C: 500M+ tokens/month (multi-quarter commit) — $550 per 1M tokens

Can you confirm the monthly spend band you expect to start with (ballpark $/month)? You mentioned the team expects to be in the low-to-mid tens of thousands to start (we heard ~$15k–$40k/month) — is that still accurate?

If that’s correct we can propose a PO-onramp path (pilot invoiced via PO or card, then converted into committed monthly PO once budget is approved).

Attachments: none in this message — I’ll loop in Monica for a formal pricing table and SOW draft.

Thanks —
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Priyom Das

Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: token economics, monthly spend band & PO path for CobaltAI

Hi Priyom —

Great demo — thanks. A few clarifying Qs so procurement can start sizing internal approvals: 

1) Can you send the exact price breakpoints you referenced for $/1M tokens (pilot rate vs commit bands)? We need the numbers to model our FY28 budget.
2) Our current month-one expectation is more like $15k–$25k (proof-of-concept). We may ramp to $60k+ in Q4 if integration goes well. Will you support a smaller initial commit or a rolling pilot that converts to a commit?
3) What is Redwood’s minimum PO amount for enterprise invoicing? We often require a PO to be sent for any invoice > $10k.
4) Payment terms: would Net 30 be standard? Would Net 45 or Net 60 be possible for startups that need extended terms?

I’ve attached a short doc with our technical requirements and our procurement template (initial_requirements.pdf). Procurement is on cc — I’m looping them to share expected lead-time and internal PO owner.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Head of Product, CobaltAI
olivia@cobaltai.com

CobaltAI
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: token economics, monthly spend band & PO path for CobaltAI (pricing + ops notes)

Priyom / Ben — quick internal ops note for the thread and what I’ll attach to our reply: 

Operational assumptions we should propose to CobaltAI (to avoid back-and-forth):
- Pilot offer: 45-day sandbox up to 100M tokens, pilot billing at $1,000 / 1M tokens. Any usage above the sandbox should be billed at pilot rates unless we convert early. Pilot invoiced by PO or card; minimum PO allowed for pilot: $25k.
- Commit bands (annualized or 12-week rolling commit):
  * 200M/month commit -> $750 per 1M tokens
  * 300M/month commit -> $650 per 1M tokens
  * 500M+/quarterly commit -> $550 per 1M tokens (requires legal SOW + 60-day lead)
- Credits: pilot fees (up to $25k) credit toward first committed month if a PO is issued within 60 days of pilot close.
- PO thresholds: for standard invoicing we typically require PO >= $25k. For anything below $25k we can accept card or ACH (self-serve).
- Payment terms: default Net 30; Net 45 can be approved for strategic accounts on a case-by-case basis (needs finance sign-off).

I’m attaching: pricing-table.csv (simple tier table) and SOW_v1.pdf (template). Please review wording on PO minimum and credits — Ben, fyi, this is aligned with the guidance we gave to other mid-market customers.

If Priyom confirms the band they’re targeting (start vs expected Q4 ramp) we’ll send a templated reply with the pricing bands + SOW + DocuSign link.

Attachments (to include in reply): pricing-table.csv, SOW_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Monica
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, procurement@cobaltai.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: token economics, monthly spend band & PO path for CobaltAI

Hi Olivia — thanks for the questions and for looping procurement. Quick commercial proposal below to unblock budgeting and the PO process. I’ve attached the SOW + pricing table for your legal/procurement team to review.

Commercial proposal summary (pilot -> commit):
1) 45-day pilot (sandbox)
   - Allowance: up to 100M tokens
   - Pilot rate: $1,000 / 1M tokens (pilot invoice will be issued; pilot fees credited toward committed contract if executed within 60 days)
   - Pilot PO minimum: $25,000 (we can invoice via PO or accept card for smaller internal POCs)

2) Commit bands (monthly) — choose one at contracting:
   - Option A (starter): 200M / month -> $750 per 1M tokens
   - Option B (scale): 300M / month -> $650 per 1M tokens
   - Option C (enterprise): 500M+ / month -> $550 per 1M tokens (requires SOW + 60-day lead for provisioning)

3) Payment & PO terms
   - Standard: Net 30.
   - Net 45: possible with finance approval for strategic customers (please flag).
   - Minimum PO for enterprise invoicing: $25k. For monthly bills below $25k, we can continue with card/ACH until procurement is ready.

Next steps we propose:
- Olivia / Procurement: confirm target starting band (we heard ~$15k–$25k to start; if that’s the case, pilot is the best path).
- We’ll issue a DocuSign for the SOW + pricing table for signature once procurement confirms PO owner and target PO date. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/XYZ-COB-291
- Timeline: pilot can begin within 5 business days of signed pilot SOW and payment method confirmed.

Attachments: SOW_v1.pdf, pricing-table.csv

If procurement wants a different PO min or payment cadence, please share your template and we’ll have Finance review.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you started.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0133
